001package org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator;
002
003import gnu.trove.iterator.TIntIntIterator;
004import gnu.trove.map.hash.TIntIntHashMap;
005import java.util.Arrays;
006import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.Propagator;
007import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.PropagatorPriority;
008import org.chocosolver.solver.exception.ContradictionException;
009import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.IntVar;
010import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.Variable;
011import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.events.IntEventType;
012import org.chocosolver.util.ESat;
013
014/**
015 *
016 * @author jimmy
017 */
018public class PropArrayToSetCard extends Propagator<Variable> {
019
020    private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
021
022    private final IntVar[] as;
023    private final IntVar sCard;
024    private final Integer globalCardinality;
025
026    public PropArrayToSetCard(IntVar[] as, IntVar sCard, Integer globalCardinality) {
027        super(buildArray(sCard, as), PropagatorPriority.LINEAR, false);
028        if (as.length == 0) {
029            throw new IllegalArgumentException();
030        }
031        this.as = as;
032        this.sCard = sCard;
033        this.globalCardinality = globalCardinality;
034    }
035
036    private static Variable[] buildArray(IntVar sCard, IntVar[] as) {
037        Variable[] array = new Variable[as.length + 1];
038        array[0] = sCard;
039        System.arraycopy(as, 0, array, 1, as.length);
040        return array;
041    }
042
043    private boolean isAVar(int idx) {
044        return idx >= 1;
045    }
046
047    private int getAVarIndex(int idx) {
048        assert isAVar(idx);
049        return idx - 1;
050    }
051
052    private boolean isSCardVar(int idx) {
053        return idx == 0;
054    }
055
056    public boolean hasGlobalCardinality() {
057        return globalCardinality != null;
058    }
059
060    public int getGlobalCardinality() {
061        assert hasGlobalCardinality();
062        return globalCardinality.intValue();
063    }
064
065    @Override
066    public int getPropagationConditions(int vIdx) {
067        if (isAVar(vIdx)) {
068            return IntEventType.instantiation();
069        }
070        assert isSCardVar(vIdx);
071        return IntEventType.boundAndInst();
072    }
073
074    private int countAdditionalSameRefsAllowed(TIntIntHashMap map) {
075        assert hasGlobalCardinality();
076        int gc = getGlobalCardinality();
077
078        int allowed = 0;
079
080        if (gc != 1) {
081            TIntIntIterator iter = map.iterator();
082            for (int i = map.size(); i-- > 0;) {
083                iter.advance();
084                assert iter.value() > 0;
085                assert iter.value() <= gc;
086                allowed += gc - iter.value();
087            }
088            assert !iter.hasNext();
089        }
090
091        return allowed;
092    }
093
094    private TIntIntHashMap countRefs() {
095        TIntIntHashMap map = new TIntIntHashMap(as.length);
096        for (IntVar a : as) {
097            if (a.isInstantiated()) {
098                map.adjustOrPutValue(a.getValue(), 1, 1);
099            }
100        }
101        return map;
102    }
103
104    private TIntIntHashMap constrainGlobalCardinality() throws ContradictionException {
105        assert hasGlobalCardinality();
106        TIntIntHashMap map = new TIntIntHashMap(as.length);
107        for (int i = 0; i < as.length; i++) {
108            constrainGlobalCardinality(i, i, map);
109        }
110        assert map.size() == countRefs().size();
111        return map;
112    }
113
114    private void constrainGlobalCardinality(int index, int explored, TIntIntHashMap map) throws ContradictionException {
115        assert hasGlobalCardinality();
116        assert index <= explored;
117        assert explored < as.length;
118
119        IntVar a = as[index];
120        if (a.isInstantiated()) {
121            int value = a.getValue();
122            int count = map.adjustOrPutValue(value, 1, 1);
123            int gc = getGlobalCardinality();
124
125            if (count == gc) {
126                for (int j = 0; j < explored; j++) {
127                    IntVar b = as[j];
128                    if (!b.isInstantiatedTo(value) && b.removeValue(value, this)) {
129                        constrainGlobalCardinality(j, explored, map);
130                    }
131                }
132                for (int j = explored + 1; j < as.length; j++) {
133                    as[j].removeValue(value, this);
134                }
135            } else if (count > gc) {
136                fails();
137            }
138        }
139    }
140
141    private static int divRoundUp(int a, int b) {
142        assert a >= 0;
143        assert b > 0;
144
145        return (a + b - 1) / b;
146    }
147
148    @Override
149    public void propagate(int evtmask) throws ContradictionException {
150        boolean changed;
151        do {
152            changed = false;
153            TIntIntHashMap map = hasGlobalCardinality() ? constrainGlobalCardinality() : countRefs();
154            int instCard = map.size();
155            int uninstantiated = 0;
156            for (IntVar a : as) {
157                if (!a.isInstantiated()) {
158                    uninstantiated++;
159                }
160            }
161            int minCard = Math.max(1, instCard
162                    + (hasGlobalCardinality()
163                    ? divRoundUp(Math.max(0, uninstantiated - countAdditionalSameRefsAllowed(map)), getGlobalCardinality())
164                    : 0));
165            int maxCard = instCard + uninstantiated;
166
167            sCard.updateLowerBound(minCard, this);
168            sCard.updateUpperBound(maxCard, this);
169
170            if (uninstantiated != 0) {
171                if (instCard == sCard.getUB()) {
172                    // The rest must be duplicates.
173                    for (IntVar a : as) {
174                        assert !a.isInstantiated() || map.contains(a.getValue());
175                        if (!a.isInstantiated()) {
176                            changed |= PropUtil.domSubsetSet(a, map.keySet(), this) && a.isInstantiated();
177                        }
178                    }
179                }
180                if (maxCard == sCard.getLB()) {
181                    // No more duplicate values.
182                    for (IntVar a : as) {
183                        if (!a.isInstantiated()) {
184                            TIntIntIterator iter = map.iterator();
185                            for (int i = map.size(); i-- > 0;) {
186                                iter.advance();
187                                changed |= a.removeValue(iter.key(), this) && a.isInstantiated();
188                            }
189                            assert !iter.hasNext();
190                        }
191                    }
192                }
193            }
194        } while (changed);
195    }
196
197    @Override
198    public ESat isEntailed() {
199        TIntIntHashMap map = new TIntIntHashMap();
200        int gc = hasGlobalCardinality() ? getGlobalCardinality() : Integer.MAX_VALUE;
201        int uninstantiated = 0;
202        for (IntVar a : as) {
203            if (a.isInstantiated()) {
204                if (map.adjustOrPutValue(a.getValue(), 1, 1) > gc) {
205                    return ESat.FALSE;
206                }
207            } else {
208                uninstantiated++;
209            }
210        }
211
212        int instCard = map.size();
213        int minCard = instCard
214                + (hasGlobalCardinality()
215                ? divRoundUp(Math.max(0, uninstantiated - countAdditionalSameRefsAllowed(map)), getGlobalCardinality())
216                : 0);
217        int maxCard = instCard + uninstantiated;
218
219        if (sCard.getUB() < minCard) {
220            return ESat.FALSE;
221        }
222        if (sCard.getLB() > maxCard) {
223            return ESat.FALSE;
224        }
225
226        return uninstantiated == 0 ? ESat.TRUE : ESat.UNDEFINED;
227    }
228
229    @Override
230    public String toString() {
231        return "arrayToSetCard(" + Arrays.toString(as) + ", " + sCard + ", " + globalCardinality + ")";
232    }
233}
